nodes.author: Claude Sonnet 4.6
nodes.label: Graphify Evaluation - httpx Corpus (2026-04-03)
nodes.rationale: Bash execution was unavailable, so the evaluation used full deterministic code tracing of every graphify module against the corpus; counts are estimated because the exact Leiden partition is non-deterministic.

nodes.label: _make_id()
nodes.rationale: Method node IDs are built as _make_id(parent_class_nid, func_name) so IDs are scoped to stem_classname_methodname and edge endpoints match registered node IDs.

nodes.label: Edge clean step (valid_ids filter)
nodes.rationale: Edges whose target was never registered in seen_ids are dropped, except for import relations which are kept even without a matching target node.

nodes.label: Issue 1: Inheritance edges silently dropped (CRITICAL)
nodes.rationale: Base classes not defined in the same file (Exception, ABC, dict, Mapping) never get registered node IDs, so all 14 inheritance edges are filtered at the clean step; the fix is to create stub external base-class nodes or keep inheritance edges regardless.

nodes.label: Issue 2: File nodes dominate God Nodes (MODERATE)
nodes.rationale: Every file gets a synthetic hub node with a contains edge to each definition, inflating file degree above real abstractions; fix is to exclude .py labels from ranking or report them separately as Module Hubs.

nodes.label: Issue 3: Transport and Auth merged into one community (MODERATE)
nodes.rationale: auth.py and transport.py both import models and exceptions but have no direct structural link, so sparse connectivity makes Leiden group architecturally distinct layers together.

nodes.label: Issue 4: 100% EXTRACTED, 0% INFERRED (MODERATE)
nodes.rationale: Pure AST extraction captures only structural facts, missing calls, conceptual relations and implements edges - roughly 20% of the semantically interesting relationships; a lightweight name-based call-detection pass would add INFERRED edges.

nodes.label: Issue 5: Surprising connections surface obvious imports (MINOR)
nodes.rationale: All cross-file edges are ranked equally and the AMBIGUOUS->INFERRED->EXTRACTED sort degenerates when everything is EXTRACTED; a distance metric preferring file pairs with no direct import would rank DigestAuth->Response above transport->exceptions.

nodes.label: Issue 6: _make_id edge fix confirmed working
nodes.rationale: Both the method node ID and the method edge endpoint use the same parent_class_nid, so the previously reported 27% method-edge drop no longer occurs; roughly 35-40 edges are saved across ~45 methods.

nodes.label: Issue 7: Concept node filtering confirmed working
_is_concept_node()
nodes.rationale: Filters nodes with empty source_file or a source_file with no extension, so AST-extracted entities are never mistaken for concept nodes.

nodes.label: DigestAuth
nodes.rationale: DigestAuth must inspect Response (WWW-Authenticate header, 401 status) to build its challenge response, making auth a request-response cycle participant rather than a pure pre-request decorator.

nodes.label: AST-only pipeline ceiling (25-30% of relationships)
nodes.rationale: Structural extraction is deterministic, fast and accurate but cannot see call flow or semantics, so the graph is structurally correct yet semantically thin for code corpora.

nodes.label: What a 9/10 graph would look like
skill.md LLM extraction pass (Step 3)
nodes.rationale: The design envisions the LLM doing richer extraction for document/paper corpora, while code currently relies entirely on tree-sitter.

nodes.label: Corpus-size warning (fits in a single context window)
nodes.rationale: At ~2,800 words and 6 files the corpus is small for graph analysis; graph value increases with larger corpora where file-level connectivity creates meaningful community structure.

nodes.label: 94 stdlib import validation warnings
nodes.rationale: The AST extractor emits import edges to stdlib names before the validator can prune them, so they are discarded but inflate the pre-pruning edge count.

nodes.rationale: Config scripts have no functions, so they land as isolates; 36 of 53 communities are single nodes - correct behavior but visually noisy.

nodes.label: Pipeline: detect -> extract -> build -> cluster -> analyze -> query -> feedback loop
Feedback loop (query answers filed back into library)
nodes.rationale: Query results saved as markdown are picked up by the next detect() scan and extracted as nodes on --update, so the graph grows from what you ask, not just what you add.

nodes.label: Arabic image OCR via vision
nodes.rationale: No reshaper, bidi or language-specific preprocessing is needed because the vision model reads RTL scripts identically to English; the image node is just a path.

nodes.label: Issue 1: suggest_questions() returns empty on small corpora
nodes.rationale: It needs AMBIGUOUS edges, bridge nodes or underexplored god nodes as signal; correct behavior, but the skill should handle the empty case gracefully.

nodes.label: Issue 2: god_nodes() empty when all nodes are file-level
nodes.rationale: File hub nodes are correctly excluded, but on a 3-file corpus that leaves nothing; a 'corpus too small' notice is preferable to a silent empty list.

nodes.label: Issue 3: zero surprising connections on cleanly-layered code (not a bug)
nodes.rationale: The three modules never import each other and connect only through external deps, so there are no cross-community edges to surface.

nodes.author: Vaswani et al., 2017
nodes.label: Transformer Architecture
nodes.rationale: Eschews recurrence entirely and relies on attention to draw global dependencies between input and output.

nodes.label: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
nodes.rationale: Scaling by sqrt(d_k) prevents dot products from growing large in magnitude, which would push the softmax into regions with very small gradients.

nodes.label: Decoder Stack (6 layers, masked self-attention)
nodes.rationale: Self-attention is masked so positions cannot attend to subsequent positions.

nodes.label: Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
nodes.rationale: The model has no recurrence or convolution, so positional encodings are added to input embeddings to convey relative token position.

nodes.label: Why attention over recurrence (3 advantages)
nodes.rationale: Lower per-layer complexity when sequence length is below representation dimensionality, full parallelization versus O(n) sequential recurrent ops, and O(1) path length for long-range dependencies.

nodes.label: WMT 2014 results (28.4 BLEU EN-DE, 41.0 BLEU EN-FR)
Open questions (h=8 generality, sqrt(d_k) theory, learned vs sinusoidal PE)
